 Floyd Samba ‘could be loaned’ in January 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Floyd Samba , the 17-year-old Germany U19 and Manchester City midfielder, could be allowed out on loan in January. Sky Germany reports that a temporary move is being considered, with several clubs interested and a switch to Germany possible.
 Samba has broken into City’s senior squad this season, making two appearances.
 OneFootball Videos
 He scored twice on debut in a 5-0 EFL Cup win over Norwich City.
 He then made his Champions League bow in midweek, deployed up front as Erling Haaland was rested.
 Competition for his preferred central midfield role is intense, with Elliot Anderson, Ayyoub Bouaddi and Enzo Fernández among the options.
 Born in Macclesfield to Republic of the Congo international Christopher Samba and a German mother, he represented England at U15, U16 and U17 level before switching allegiance to Germany.
